facts.fact: The Council of Ministers states on 22 April 2026 that the computerised national civil status register is operational in 102 communes, with work continuing to computerise the others; it gives no total of communes and does not say the communes are online.
facts.system: registre national de l'etat civil informatise

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers states on 22 April 2026 that the computerised national civil status register, developed under the 2019 civil status law, is operational in 102 communes; the communique does not say how the communes reach it.
facts.system: registre national de l'etat civil informatise

systems.tiers: operational in 102 communes at 22 April 2026; the other communes still to be computerised

systems.owner: ANEI, created the same day under the Ministry of the Interior

note: The two facts rest on one sentence: a national register 'operational in 102 communes'. The communique states computerisation, not a connection, and names no link, so the parent should decide whether this is working in a national system (a connection) or a count of communes computerised (equipped, application class only).
